rationale: All three prior-round findings are resolved by the fix-up diff. CR-001: `requested_file_names = [n for n in requested_file_names if n]` inserted before the empty-guard so {file:''}/{file:null}/{files:[null]} collapse into the no-names branch — verified by 3 new tests (empty string, None, all-falsy list). CR-002: added `from codemie.core.constants import ChatRole` and `m.role == ChatRole.USER` role filter to the user_messages comprehension — verified by test_assistant_role_message_with_files_does_not_shadow_latest_user_turn. CR-003 (variant b as selected): latest_user_turn_index now computed over ALL user messages in scope (not just those with files) and the emit loop retains `and message.file_names`, so edit-to-empty of the latest turn yields nothing rather than walking back — verified by test_edit_to_empty_of_latest_user_turn_does_not_fall_back_to_prior_turn. No new high-risk issues introduced by the fix-up (no security surface, no public API, no runtime hazard); scoped blind+edge-case confirmation pass not required. Confidence high.
